testCaseMappings.title: Principal: isolate assigned vessels
testCaseMappings.expectedStatus: Only crew assigned to Vessel A returned; Vessel B and unassigned crew U001 excluded from all pages
testCaseMappings.setupValidationQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tbl_user_assigned_vessel uav JOIN tbl_users u ON uav.user_id=u.id WHERE u.username='qa.c2.20261001.principal';
testCaseMappings.preconditionReadiness: Fully satisfied by dedicated principal account and single-vessel assignment
testCaseMappings.remainingPrerequisites: Set UMMI_PRINCIPAL_USER and UMMI_PRINCIPAL_PASSWORD in qa/playwright/.env

testCaseMappings.title: Hide unavailable CCL links
testCaseMappings.expectedStatus: Eligible statuses (On Board, Line Up, Vacation) clickable with CCL perm; Inactive (A003) renders as plain text; Unassigned (U001) is blank; Without CCL perm all render as plain text
testCaseMappings.setupValidationQuery: SELECT crew_status, firstname FROM tbl_personnel_info WHERE email_address IN ('qa-c2-20261001-a001@example.com', 'qa-c2-20261001-a002@example.com', 'qa-c2-20261001-a003@example.com', 'qa-c2-20261001-u001@example.com');
testCaseMappings.preconditionReadiness: Fully satisfied: Eligible vs Inactive vs Unassigned crew states provisioned

testCaseMappings.title: Open correct scanned document
testCaseMappings.expectedStatus: CrewDocumentHandler.ashx streams QA-C2-RUN-20261001-C2P1-LIC-A001.pdf with Content-Type application/pdf and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
testCaseMappings.setupValidationQuery: SELECT img_id FROM tbl_personnel_documents pd JOIN tbl_personnel_info p ON pd.personnel_id=p.id WHERE p.email_address='qa-c2-20261001-a001@example.com' AND pd.document_num='QA-C2-RUN-20261001-C2P1-LIC-A001-NUM';
testCaseMappings.preconditionReadiness: Database metadata satisfied. Server file upload required prior to execution.

testCaseMappings.title: Record without a scan
testCaseMappings.documentOrAttachment: Metadata record only (img_id IS NULL, doc_num QA-C2-RUN-20261001-C2P1-NOSCAN-A001-NUM)
testCaseMappings.expectedStatus: Document table renders row with metadata but scan viewer link/action is disabled/absent
testCaseMappings.setupValidationQuery: SELECT document_num FROM tbl_personnel_documents pd JOIN tbl_personnel_info p ON pd.personnel_id=p.id WHERE p.email_address='qa-c2-20261001-a001@example.com' AND pd.img_id IS NULL;
testCaseMappings.preconditionReadiness: Fully satisfied by database fixture setup (no file upload needed)

testCaseMappings.title: Open assessment attachment
testCaseMappings.expectedStatus: AssessmentAttachmentHandler.ashx streams QA-C2-RUN-20261001-C2P1-A001-ASSESS.pdf with application/pdf and nosniff protection; popup closes without mutating notes

testCaseMappings.title: Protected document and assessment access
